tickets.text: Trigger h1_close_above:bar_high buys above yesterday's high after a Creek pull-in; Elder's buy rests at or slightly under a rising average after a pullback into value (C10), and the last bar is green going away, a booking bar (C4).

Trigger h1_close_above:bar_high after a Creek pull-in is a breakout buy; my method buys the pullback into value under a rising average (C10), and the last bar shows green going away (C4), not a permission event.

Add trigger close_above:bar_high on D buys a new high on a held name whose last bar is a single-bar drop, green going away; R7 reads that as TIGHTEN, and an add belongs on the value pullback (C4, C10).

ADVANCE on h1_close_above:bar_high buys before the pullback resolves; elder_5d [10, 10, 7, 7, 7] is green faded, holding not-red, a pullback in progress with no transition yet (C3, C4). Entry belongs on the value reclaim (C10).
